description: Returns matching products and their ids for a name, model number, barcode (UPC/EAN), or a brand plus category such as 'eufy security cameras'. One call returns up to 10 products, with the stores that list each one and a link to each product's Divux page. Prices and stock are for online delivery in the US. An empty result means no product matched the query. Recall notices are not part of this result. Applies to questions about finding a specific product, or a brand's range, to buy in the US.

condition.description: new or used. 'used' includes open-box and refurbished. Default is new.

in_stock_only.description: Only products with at least one in-stock offer

query.description: A product name, model number or UPC/EAN, e.g. 'Sony WH-1000XM6' or '045496884963', or a brand plus category, e.g. 'eufy security cameras'

name: search_products
title: Shopper: search products
